title.en: Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88

mvt.ja: 第2楽章 アダージョ【スケッチ】

blurb.ja: 簡略スケッチ（原曲の構成・テンポ・強弱の流れにもとづく推定。音符は原曲と同じではありません）。ゆったりした4つ振りで、強弱の波を学ぶ練習向き。
blurb.en: Sketch: structure, tempo and dynamics follow the original; the notes are approximate and not identical to the score. A slow four, good for practising the dynamic swells.

src.credit: Composition: Dvořák (public domain). Score reading source: IMSLP #405841 (Novello 1892 / Dover, public domain). Sketch by this site. Sketch: structure, tempo and dynamics follow the original; the notes are approximate and not identical to the score.
